title: Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test SET Online Form 2026
postName: Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test (CG SET) – Assistant Professor Eligibility
vacancyDetails: State Eligibility Test for Assistant Professor eligibility in Chhattisgarh colleges and universities (not a vacancy recruitment)
qualification: Master’s degree in concerned subject with minimum marks as per UGC / CG SET rules (Ph.D. / NET exemptions as applicable in notification)
ageLimit: No upper age limit for SET eligibility (as per official rules)
applicationFee: As per CG SET 2026 fee structure (category-wise)
selectionProcess: Paper-I (General) + Paper-II (Subject) → Merit / Qualifying as per CG SET rules
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in or https://cgssb.cgstate.gov.in
2. Complete profile registration on vyapamprofile.cgstate.gov.in
3. Open CG SET 2026 online application
4. Fill form, upload photo/signature, pay fee
5. Submit and print confirmation
shortDescription: Chhattisgarh SET Online Form 2026 – apply for CG SET Assistant Professor eligibility. Last date 17 August 2026. Exam on 4 October 2026.
content:
Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board / CGSSB has released the CG SET 2026 notification for the Chhattisgarh State Eligibility Test.

CG SET determines eligibility for the post of Assistant Professor in colleges and universities of Chhattisgarh. Online applications are open from 23 July 2026 to 17 August 2026.

The exam is scheduled on 4 October 2026. Apply only through the official Vyapam / CGSSB portals after completing profile registration.
